title: E-commerce photo studio: how to set it up for your internal packshots?
h1: E-commerce photo studio: automation and organization
metaTitle: How to organize an internal e-commerce photo studio? | Orbitvu & PackshotCreator
description: Learn how to structure your internal e-commerce photo studio with Orbitvu and PackshotCreator. Automation, AI, and efficient organization to produce professional visuals independently.
author: Laurent Wainberg
content:
We have already explored the good budgetary and logistical practices to internalize visual production through an e-commerce photo studio. Today, let's focus on organizational and human aspects.

Why internalize your visual production?

One of the great advantages of solutions Orbitvu, distributed in France and Switzerland by PackshotCreator, is of simplify image production as much as possible. Thanks to theautomation, to preconfigurable settings And to a intuitive interface, you no longer need a dedicated photographer. Your team can produce professional visuals independently, without special technical skills.

The integration of a internal e-commerce photo studio allows you to:
✅ To speed up your product shootings with automatic settings
✅ To ensure consistent quality on all your visuals
✅ To reduce costs linked to external service providers
✅ To integrate visual production into your workflow

What are the roles for optimized production?

Even if an automated photo studio reduces the need for specialized personnel, it is important to have a clear organization. Here are the key roles to structure your visual production internally:

1. Project manager — The strategist 🎯

He oversees the entire process : visual management, production monitoring and quality control.
With Orbitvu, planning becomes more fluid and predictable thanks to the automation of shots and exports. No more wasting time related to manual retouching and adjustments.

2. Photographer — The agile performer 📸

Even without technical experience, you can capture perfect images thanks to intelligent presets with built-in AI To the solutions Orbitvu.
👉 Increase speed : switch from one product to another in one click
👉 Optimize every shot : settings are saved for consistent quality

3. Assistant — The coordinator 🔄

He manages the organization and the flow of products to be photographed.
💡 Thanks to the tools Orbitvu, the automation of shooting makes it possible to considerably reduce handling time and to increase productivity.

4. Publisher — The guarantor of quality ✨

With the integrated tools of the solutions Orbitvu, editing becomes ultra-simple :
✅ Automatic removal of funds
✅ AI-optimized lighting corrections
✅ Multi-format exports in one click

💡 Result: no need for complex software, you save precious time and ensure consistent quality on all your visuals.

Measurable productivity gains

Many companies that have integrated a Orbitvu photo studio internally, there are significant gains in speed and efficiency.
✔ Reduction in shooting time thanks to the automation of settings
✔ Better visual consistency without complex retouching
✔ Increase in the volume of visuals produced without additional resources

Conclusion: Gain autonomy and efficiency with Orbitvu

Thanks to Orbitvu solutions, managing an internal e-commerce photo studio is becoming a strategic asset. THEautomation and artificial intelligence allow quickly produce professional visuals, even without a dedicated team.

faqs.question: Why internalize an e-commerce photo studio?
faqs.answer: Internalizing an e-commerce photo studio makes it possible to reduce costs, speed up image production, and ensure consistent quality. Thanks to Orbitvu solutions, even a team with no photography experience can produce professional visuals independently.

faqs.question: What are the benefits of Orbitvu solutions for e-commerce photography?
faqs.answer: Orbitvu offers advanced automation (light settings, background removal, multi-format export) and an intuitive interface. This saves time and optimizes shootings without manual intervention.

faqs.question: Do you need a professional photographer to use an Orbitvu studio?
faqs.answer: No, Orbitvu solutions are designed to be used without technical skills. Thanks to pre-configured settings and built-in AI, it's possible to capture perfect visuals in just a few clicks.

faqs.question: How long does it take to form a team at Orbitvu?
faqs.answer: Orbitvu solutions are designed for quick handling. In general, a few hours of training is enough for your team to master the studio and start producing quality visuals.

faqs.question: How to improve the productivity of an e-commerce photo studio?
faqs.answer: To maximize efficiency, it is essential to automate shooting and editing with Orbitvu, to define clear roles within the team, and to use presets to ensure consistent quality across all visuals produced.
